assessment.nobel_worthiness: A foundational physiological discovery translated into a major therapeutic approach for diabetes and obesity, with broad and consequential medical impact.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio captures discovery of the physiological pathway, identification of its biologically active form, and its development as a therapeutic concept.
assessment.maturity: The physiology and clinical consequences have been tested over decades, and the medical impact is now unmistakable.
uncertainties: The appropriate balance between physiological discovery and pharmaceutical development remains a difficult attribution boundary.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics created a qualitatively new ability to test causal roles of defined cells in intact physiology and has reshaped neuroscience.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates represent the key microbial photoreceptor work and its decisive deployment for genetically targeted neural control.
assessment.maturity: The method is mature, broadly adopted, and has generated sustained conceptual and experimental impact.
uncertainties: Several additional contributors listed on the candidate make a three-person allocation necessarily incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Human genetics established PCSK9 as a compelling therapeutic target and enabled an important new approach to cholesterol lowering.
assessment.attribution: The selected names emphasize the human genetic observations that provided unusually strong causal validation of the target.
assessment.maturity: Genetic evidence, mechanism, and clinical therapeutic translation now form a coherent and mature body of evidence.
uncertainties: Credit for discovery of the pathway and for therapeutic validation is distributed among more investigators than can be recognized.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical coherence tomography provided a transformative noninvasive means to visualize living tissue and changed clinical ophthalmology and biomedical research.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio closely corresponds to the foundational development and demonstration of the imaging modality.
assessment.maturity: Its extensive clinical use and durable technological influence establish both maturity and medical significance.
uncertainties: The extent to which this engineering-centered advance best fits the intended scope of the medicine prize may be debated.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Identification of BCL11A control of fetal hemoglobin opened a rational route to treat severe inherited hemoglobin disorders.
assessment.attribution: The selected investigators represent the mechanistic genetic insight and its development toward therapeutic reactivation.
assessment.maturity: The discovery has advanced from regulatory biology to clinically consequential intervention, supporting timely recognition.
uncertainties: The respective credit due to broader fetal-hemoglobin genetics and to later therapeutic implementation requires careful delimitation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Functional rescue of mutant CFTR converted molecular understanding into disease-modifying treatment for many people with cystic fibrosis.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names connect core CFTR functional biology with the development of practical modulator therapies.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic effect has been established in clinical practice and represents a durable translational advance.
uncertainties: Important contributions to medicinal chemistry and clinical development extend beyond a three-person award.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle vaccination against HPV has prevented infections that cause major human cancers, demonstrating exceptional preventive medical value.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio represents the central conceptual and experimental work underlying the prophylactic vaccine platform.
assessment.maturity: Longstanding global deployment and accumulating population-level benefit make the achievement fully mature.
uncertainties: The relationship between this work and prior recognition of papillomavirus causation of cervical cancer requires clear framing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: High-frequency deep brain stimulation established a powerful treatment for Parkinson's disease and altered the practice of functional neurosurgery.
assessment.attribution: The candidate identifies a clear originating contributor to the high-frequency stimulation approach.
assessment.maturity: Its long clinical record, broad adoption, and continued relevance support recognition.
uncertainties: The contribution is a therapeutic physiological intervention whose credit also intersects with wider work on targets, devices, and clinical refinement.
